blocks.text: Bunyadi zarre chhe quarks, chhe leptons aur gauge bosons (aur Higgs boson) mane jate hain; gauge bosons bunyadi forces ke carrier hain. Leptons aur quarks bosons bhej kar aur wasool kar ke aapas mein taamul karte hain. Maslan electromagnetic taamulat tab hote hain jab do charged zarre photons bhejte aur wasool (tabadla) karte hain; kaha jata hai ke photons charged zarron ke darmiyan force 'le jate' hain. Isi tarah atomi nucleus mein do quarks ki kashish tab hoti hai jab quarks gluons bhejte aur wasool karte hain. Isi tarah W+, W- aur Z bosons weak nuclear force ke carrier hain, aur gravitons gravitational force ke tajweez shuda carrier hain.

blocks.title: Higgs boson
blocks.text: Higgs boson khaas zarra hai jo 2012 mein CERN ke Large Hadron Collider mein daryaft hua. Yeh Higgs field se wabasta hai jo poori space mein phaili hai. Is ka aham kirdar yeh batana hai ke doosre zarre is field se taamul kar ke mass kaise pate hain.

Jo zarre Higgs field se zyada taamul karte hain woh zyada mass pate hain, jaise electroweak taamul ke carriers W+, W- aur Z bosons, jabke photons jaise zarre Higgs field se taamul nahi karte, is liye un ka rest mass sifar mana jata hai. Higgs boson ka mass taqreeban 125 giga-electron-volts (GeV) hai aur yeh jaldi doosre zarron mein decay ho jata hai. Aham haqaiq:

items: Higgs boson apna mass apni wabasta Higgs field se taamul se pata hai.
Yeh apni anokhi khusoosiyat ki wajah se Big Bang (print mein 'Bing Bang') ke foran baad ki kaainat ki halat aur dark matter ki nishaniyon ka anokha dareecha ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Jadeed physics ke nazariyat mein mass paida karne mein Higgs boson ka kirdar bataiye (short question 12.14). Bunyadi zarron ke mass ka zimmedar kaunsa zarra hai (MCQ 12.17)?
blocks.explanation: Space Higgs field se bhari hai; zarre is se taamul kar ke mass pate hain, zyada taamul karne wale jaise W aur Z bosons zyada mass pate hain, jabke photons, jo taamul nahi karte, be-mass rehte hain. Higgs boson is field ka zarra hai; 2012 mein CERN par taqreeban 125 GeV par is ki daryaft ne field ke wujood ki tasdeeq ki. MCQ 12.17 ka jawab (d), Higgs boson.

items: Bunyadi zarre: 6 quarks, 6 leptons aur bosons. Force carriers: photons (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W+, W-, Z (weak), gravitons (gravity, tajweez shuda).

Higgs boson: CERN ke Large Hadron Collider mein 2012, taqreeban 125 GeV; Higgs field zarron ko mass deti hai (W aur Z zyada, photons koi nahi); jaldi decay; ibtidai kaainat aur dark matter ka dareecha.
